description.en: 30-second cinematic action prompt paired with a source-verified creator example and its output video.
description.zh: 30 秒cinematic action提示词，保留来源、完整 Prompt 与对应输出视频。

prompt: A tiny ember drifts in darkness. It lands on dry grass and instantly ignites a chain reaction of fire that races across a field in real time. Flames morph mid-spread into molten glass, then into flowing lava rivers that carve canyons, then into rivers of liquid gold that solidify into ancient temples. The temples crack open under heat, releasing a swarm of phoenix-like firebirds that merge into one colossal bird. The bird dives into the ocean, turning the water into steam and then into a volcanic island that erupts, launching the camera into the stratosphere on a pillar of fire that becomes a rocket trail ending in a silent, glowing ember floating above Earth. Non-stop forward momentum, elemental morphing (fire → glass → lava → gold → birds → volcano), and constant camera chase.
